# Local Issue: local/run#9
M6a 分支保护、Checks 与 PR 生命周期（REQ-6-1、6-2-*、6-3-1/2）

State: open
Assignees: @glm-16
Parent: Local Issue: local/run#1

## Description

## 需求来源（权威）
需求包：`/workspace/template/.factory26/20260929-042409-1202e245/input/requirements.yaml`
原子需求：REQ-6-1（分支保护与 Checks）、REQ-6-2-1（PR 列表）、REQ-6-2-2（比较分支）、REQ-6-2-3（从比较创建 PR）、REQ-6-2-4（Draft PR 与 Ready for review）、REQ-6-3-1（PR 三视图）、REQ-6-3-2（Files changed 聚合 diff）。
参考截图：github-branch-protection.png、github-pull-requests-list.png、github-compare-branches.png、github-repository-overview.png。

## 共享决定（必须遵循）
docs/architecture.md §5（pull_requests/reviews/check_runs/branch_protections 表）、§9.2（合并语义与 merge base）、§9.5（Checks 按 (compareCommitId, name) 存储与展示；新 compare commit → pending）、权限映射（比较/创建 write+；保护规则与 Checks 状态更新 admin+）。
文案："Add branch protection rule"、"Branch name pattern"、"Require 1 approval"、"Require status check test"、"Create"/"Save changes"、"test status"/"success"/"Save"、"New pull request"、"base"/"compare"（native select，combobox role）、"Compare changes"、"Create pull request"、"Create draft pull request"、"Title is required"、"Ready for review"、"Conversation"/"Commits"/"Files changed"、"Changed files"、"<N> additions, <N> deletions" —— 进 copy.ts。

## 交付
1. 分支保护：Settings → "Branches" → 按钮 "Add branch protection rule"；表单字段 "Branch name pattern"（精确分支名，无通配）、checkbox "Require 1 approval" 与 "Require status check test"、按钮 "Create"（已有规则为 "Save changes"）；保存后规则行显示分支名与两条摘要（"1 approval"、"Require status check test"）；非 Admin 完全看不到 "Add branch protection rule"（即使可进 Branches 页）；每分支唯一规则。
2. Checks：PR 详情 Checks 区随页可用，初始显示 "test: pending"；Admin 有 combobox "test status"（option "success"）+ "Save"；保存后显示 test: success + 设置者 + 时间；刷新保持且对应同一 compare commit；compare 分支新 commit 后新 compare commit 回到 pending；仅 Admin 可改。
3. PR 列表：行显示编号/标题/作者/状态/源分支/目标分支；状态过滤 Draft/Open/Closed/Merged + 作者/评审状态；访客可直接访问公开列表；"Open" 链接过滤；标题链接精确名。
4. 比较页：链接 "New pull request"（write+ 可用；Read/Triage 不可进入创建比较流）→ native select "base"/"compare"（选项为精确分支名）+ 按钮 "Compare changes"；有效选择显示已知变更文件路径（逐字）、Commit 汇总（可比 commit 数）、enabled 的 "Create pull request"；base=compare 立即显示无差异说明并禁用创建（无需先点 Compare）；比较只读。
5. 创建 PR：比较页 "Create pull request" 打开表单（字段 "Title"、可选 "Description"、同一 "Create pull request" 提交按钮）；成功建 Open PR（仓库内唯一编号、base/compare 分支、base/compare commit、活动记录）并跳详情；空白标题 → "Title is required"；同源/目标已存在 Open 或 Draft 时不建。
6. Draft：比较页可见 "Create draft pull request"；成功显示 Draft 标记与禁用的 "Merge pull request"；Draft 不能提交评审、不能合并；作者/Maintain+/Owner 可用 "Ready for review"（如需确认则为单个 "Confirm"）转 Open 并记录活动。
7. 三视图与聚合 diff：Conversation（描述/评论/评审摘要/状态事件时间线）、Commits（相对 base 的 compare 分支 commit，含 Commit 汇总）、Files changed（含 Changed files 汇总）；三视图同一 PR 编号；访客可读公开 Open PR；diff 显示文件路径逐字与每文件增删行、聚合 "<N> additions, <N> deletions"；未变更文件不显示。
8. 后端 + Vitest（保护规则唯一性/权限、Checks 键控、比较计算、PR 编号、Draft 状态机）+ seed（PR 种子与 Fix search/Closed PR/Draft PR，见 docs/seed-data.md）。

## 前置
M4a（树/diff API 与 merge base 计算）已合入 develop；M3（仓库页入口）已合入。

## 验收
Playwright 覆盖 7 条需求场景；权限档次（控件缺席 + API 拒绝）；刷新持久化；Checks 与 compare commit 对应断言。

  name: Change Review and Merge Control
  type: FOLDER

  description: A pull request (PR) is a persistent proposal to “merge code changes
    from the compare branch into the base branch”; it is not a branch, commit, or
    issue. The Pull requests page lists the current repository's PR number, title,
    author, source/target branches, and status; “New pull request” first opens the
    comparison page, where the user selects base (the target branch that receives
    the changes) and compare (the source branch that provides the changes) and inspects
    the diff. On the PR detail page, Conversation displays the title, description,
    ordinary comments, activities, and review summary; Commits displays commits on
    the compare branch relative to base; Files changed displays per-file, per-line
    differences; Checks displays check status for the PR's current compare commit.
    A PR's persisted status may only be Draft, Open, Closed, or Merged — normal creation
    produces Open, draft creation produces Draft, and the author or Maintain/Admin
    may mark a Draft as Ready for review to transition it to Open; the author or Maintain/Admin
    may transition an unmerged Open or Draft PR to Closed and may transition Closed
    back to Open; Merged is terminal and cannot be closed or reopened. Write, Maintain,
    and Admin may add inline comments and submit reviews, the author or Maintain/Admin
    may request reviewers, and only Maintain, Admin, or organization Owner may merge.
    Each PR stores a repository-scoped number, source/target branches, creation-time
    and current compare commits, creation-time base commit, title, description, author,
    status, and activity records. When the compare branch receives a new commit, the
    system updates the current compare commit, marks all existing review decisions
    as stale while preserving them in the timeline, recalculates merge eligibility,
    and retains inline comments at their original commit and line position marked
    Outdated. Failure does not change branches or PR state. The following REQ-6 interaction
    contracts use English accessible names and apply to direct navigation as well
    as navigation from a repository. Each named action, field, and navigation link
    is unique on its active page unless explicitly repeated per changed line or reviewer.
    PR titles are headings whose accessible name is exactly the persisted title; list
    titles are links with that same exact name. Conversation, Commits, Files changed,
    and Checks are navigation links, even when visually styled as tabs. The current
    PR status is visible text. Signed-in scenarios begin with the unique Sign in link
    on the home page, labeled Username or email and Password fields, a Sign in button,
    and the account username visible after authentication; each role account has a
    username, verified email, and password. Visitor scenarios use public repositories
    and require no session. Seed records identify the corresponding pages, not to
    private implementation interfaces; role accounts, branches, PRs, and mutable state must
    be provisioned and restored independently for each scenario, including repeated
    and parallel runs. Existing titles, usernames, paths, and branch names described
    below are supplied as seed values and must be displayed verbatim; generated
    PR titles and comments may carry a unique suffix.

A “branch protection rule” is a persistent merge restriction bound to one exact branch name, displayed in the frontend under Settings → Branches, with the backend storing the branch name and rule toggles. This product supports only two independently selectable requirements: “at least 1 valid Approve from someone other than the PR author” and “required check `test` is success”. For a given reviewer on the same current compare commit, only the reviewer's latest decision among Comment, Approve, and Request changes counts. The PR author cannot satisfy the approval requirement; any valid Request changes blocks merging; when the compare branch gains a new commit, all decisions become stale and a new review is required. “Checks” is the results area on the PR detail page attached to the current compare commit; the `test` status of pending, success, or failure, together with the setter and time, must be stored, and only a repository Admin may update that status from this area. The system blocks direct writes to a protected branch and applies the rule during subsequent PR merging. The repository provides a Settings link followed by a Branches link. The rule form opens from the Add branch protection rule button and contains a field labeled Branch name pattern (an exact branch name, with no wildcard semantics), checkboxes named Require 1 approval and Require status check test, and a Create button; an existing rule uses Save changes. The Pull requests page lists the current repository's PR number, title, author, source/target branches, and status; “New pull request” first opens the comparison page, where the user selects base (the target branch that receives the changes) and compare (the source branch that provides the changes) and inspects the diff. On the PR detail page, Conversation displays the title, description, ordinary comments, activities, and review summary; Commits displays commits on the compare branch relative to base; Files changed displays per-file, per-line differences; Checks displays check status for the PR's current compare commit. A PR's persisted status may only be Draft, Open, Closed, or Merged — normal creation produces Open, draft creation produces Draft, and the author or Maintain/Admin may mark a Draft as Ready for review to transition it to Open; the author or Maintain/Admin may transition an unmerged Open or Draft PR to Closed and may transition Closed back to Open; Merged is terminal and cannot be closed or reopened. Write, Maintain, and Admin may add inline comments and submit reviews, the author or Maintain/Admin may request reviewers, and only Maintain, Admin, or organization Owner may merge.
